AdapterEndpointBindings.description:
The endpoint bindings of one deployment: the runtime members every
mode shares (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` sections 10.2 and 17).
The ingestion job's runtime document (`AdapterJobRuntimeConfig`)
states these members beside its own `sources`, `store`,
`destinations`, `secretProviders`, and `hookIngress` members; the
facade's document states them beside the facade-only members
(`secretProviders`, `listener`, `database`, `oidc`, `allowedClients`,
`audit`, `idempotency`, and the cursor custody), which
[`AdapterRuntimeConfig::endpoint_bindings`] sets aside.

allowedPrivateCidrs.description:
The private ranges egress may reach. Omission is a secure empty
allowlist for a listener-free program with no network endpoints.
The facade's `AdapterRuntimeConfig` retains its nonempty requirement.

outboundTls.description:
The private CAs endpoints may trust beside the system roots;
absent, every endpoint trusts the system roots alone.

anyOf.description: Accept a token from every client.
Accept a token only from a listed client.

AllowedClients.description:
The OAuth clients whose tokens a runtime accepts: the keyword
`unrestricted`, or a list of at least one client.

AnonymousHttpsAcknowledgement.description: The operator reviewed and approved this fixed anonymous source.

AuditDestinationKind.description: The configured audit destination kind, as written in product configuration.

oneOf.description: One JSON line per entry on standard output, flushed per entry.

Cidr.description: A private network range in `addr/prefix` form, for example 10.0.0.0/8.

ClaimName.description:
The name of one top-level claim of an access token. The reader accepts any
text; the runtime then refuses a name that is not a valid claim name, one
that repeats another contextual name, and one that is a registered or
authentication claim.

CredentialPlacement.description:
Where a shared client secret travels, Evidence's `CredentialPlacement`
spelling.

oneOf.description: A form parameter on the token request.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

EndpointBinding.description:
The environment binding of one pack endpoint: its base URL, its
credentials matching the endpoint's declared kind, and the optional TLS
additions (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.2).

anonymousHttps.description:
The operator's explicit acknowledgement that a credential-free
source is intentionally served over verified HTTPS. Omission keeps
the credential-free policy closed outside numeric loopback and mTLS.

baseUrl.description:
The upstream origin; a fixed destination the engine never derives
from a response.

credential.description: The credential; its kind must match the endpoint's declared kind.

endpoint.description: The pack endpoint this binding configures.

maximumConcurrency.description:
The maximum simultaneous physical data operations admitted for this
endpoint. Evidence programs selecting the same named connection share
one permit pool; token acquisition retains its own cache/single-flight
controls.

maximumResponseBytes.description:
A lower response bound than the pack declares, in bytes (1 to
16777216, the largest bound a pack endpoint may declare); absent, the
declared one applies. A value above the declared one is refused when
the deployment loads.

mtlsIdentity.description: The mTLS client identity, combinable with any authentication kind.

tlsTrustProfile.description:
A trust profile under `outboundTls.trustProfiles` whose CA bundle
the endpoint trusts beside the system roots; absent, the endpoint
trusts the system roots alone.

EnvironmentSecretProviderConfig.description: The environment secret provider. It takes no settings.

EvidenceAuthenticationPolicy.description:
The non-secret authentication authority reviewed with an Evidence source
connection. Pack endpoints still own API-intrinsic fields such as an API
key header name or authorization scheme; runtime bindings own only secret
references and operational cache bounds.

EvidenceClientIdentityPolicy.description: The reviewed client-identity posture of one Evidence connection.

EvidenceConnectionPolicy.description:
One reviewed Evidence connection policy from the governed bundle. Runtime
bindings supply material and deployment values, but may not select a
different destination or trust posture from this policy.

authentication.description:
The reviewed non-secret authentication authority. Credential material
and cache tuning stay in the runtime binding, but an OAuth token
destination or request audience cannot be selected there alone.

baseUrl.description: The exact reviewed origin and base path.

clientIdentity.description: Whether the runtime must or must not supply an mTLS identity.

endpoint.description: The pack endpoint whose reviewed authentication kind applies.

tlsTrustProfile.description: The exact private trust profile selection; `None` means system roots.

baseUrl.description:
The Evidence service's base URL. It is `https`; `http` is accepted
only for a loopback host, for local development.

caBundleRef.description:
PEM CA bundle for the Evidence service and its token endpoint.
Omitted, the platform's trusted roots verify them.

privateKeyJwt.description:
The refreshing credential: a private-key JWT client exchange.
Exactly one of `tokenRef` and `privateKeyJwt` is written.

tokenRef.description:
Compatibility path for a pre-issued token. Long-running providers
should configure `privateKeyJwt` so expiry triggers a fresh exchange.
Exactly one of `tokenRef` and `privateKeyJwt` is written.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

ExternalRefreshConfig.description: The optional `externalRefresh` runtime block. Empty is the omission default.

ExternalSourceBinding.description:
Operator binding for one already declared projection. The reviewed pack
provides the acquisition ceiling; runtime configuration can narrow it.

cacheTtlSeconds.description:
An optional shorter cache lifetime for an indexed projection. The
cache keeps a value for the shorter of this and the authored
cacheTtlSeconds, then purges it. A live projection refuses it.

grantValidUntil.description: The reviewed source grant cutoff, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

root.description:
Absolute directory holding one file per secret. Each file must be a
regular file owned by the runtime user, mode 0400 or 0600, with exactly
one hard link.

JwksSource.description: Where a runtime obtains the OIDC issuer's signing keys.

oneOf.description: Read `jwks_uri` from the issuer's OpenID Connect discovery document.

Fetch the key set from this absolute `https` URI, skipping discovery.
A plain `http` URI is accepted on loopback for supervised local
development, and beyond loopback only when the issuer block sets
`allowInsecureHttp`.

Read the key set from a secret, for deployments without network access
to the issuer.

ListenerBind.description: Socket address the runtime listens on, written host:port with an IP address host ([addr]:port for IPv6).

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

LogLevel.description:
The operational log level selected by the runtime file when `BREG_LOG`
is not set. The closed vocabulary prevents configuration from enabling
debug output or dependency logging.

MtlsIdentity.description:
The mTLS client identity of an endpoint, orthogonal to the
authentication kind (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.2). It is
one way a `none` endpoint reaches a non-loopback source. An operator may
instead acknowledge a credential-free HTTPS source on its fixed runtime
binding.

keyRef.description: The client private key secret reference.

OutboundTls.description:
The private certificate authorities endpoints may trust beside the
system roots (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.2), in the shape
Evidence ships: a named profile is a process-local PEM file. A CA
bundle is not a secret, so the profile names a file, never a secret
reference.

oneOf.description:
One S3-compatible bucket a runtime keeps content bytes in, and the
runtime's credentials for it. The decode checks only the shape; the
object-store transport refuses a non-loopback `http` URL, a URL carrying a
path, query, or fragment, and a malformed bucket or region name before it
sends anything.

attemptTimeoutMilliseconds.description: The longest one request may run, body included. Omitted, 10000.

bucket.description: The bucket name: lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `.`.

caBundleRef.description:
PEM CA bundle for the service. Omitted, the platform's trusted roots
verify it.

pathStyle.description:
Address the bucket as a path under `url` rather than as a host name.
Omitted, `true`.

region.description: The signing region: lowercase letters, digits and `-`.

url.description:
The service's base URL, with no path. It is `https`; `http` is
accepted only for a loopback host, for local development.

oneOf.description:
One external HTTP verifier a runtime submits content bytes to for an
`approved` or `rejected` verdict, and the runtime's bearer credential for
it. The block carries no default: a runtime that makes verification
optional states its own disabled form beside it.

attemptTimeoutMilliseconds.description:
The longest one verification attempt may run, body included.
Omitted, 10000.

policyId.description: Non-secret identity of the external scanner and its rules generation.

url.description:
The URL the content is posted to. It is `https`; `http` is accepted
only for a loopback host, for local development.

RawAuditConfig.description:
The key for the keyed references an audit record carries in place of raw
identifiers, written `audit.hashKeyRef` beside the product's own audit
settings.

destination.description:
`file` (the default) writes a durable, rotated JSON Lines file at
`path`; `stdout` writes one JSON line per entry to standard output.

hashKeyRef.description: Secret reference to the audit hash key.

path.description:
Absolute path of the active audit file. Required for, and accepted
only with, the `file` destination; omitted with `stdout`.

retentionDays.description:
Days a rotated file is retained, accepted only with the `file`
destination. Omitted, a rotated file is retained for 90 days.

rotateBytes.description:
Size in bytes at which the active file rotates, accepted only with the
`file` destination. Omitted, the file rotates at 100 MiB.

contextual.description:
The claim names that carry delegated-authority context. Each name
defaults to its `registry_` claim; written, every name is given.

maximumAgeSeconds.description: Defaults to the bounded cursor validity lifetime.

RawDestinationsConfig.description: Outbound destination bindings, grouped by what sends to them.

hooks.description: URL hook destinations, keyed by the identifier a reviewed hook names.

allowedPrivateCidrs.description: Explicitly allowed private network ranges in canonical CIDR notation.

classificationCeiling.description: Highest permitted classification, including fields used only in event conditions.

deliveryCeilings.description: Per-destination limits that may tighten, but never increase, the compiled delivery limits.

dnsFamily.description: Address families to validate when resolving the destination.

hmacSha256KeyRef.description: Runtime secret reference for the receiver's shared HMAC-SHA-256 key.

networkProfile.description: HTTPS for production, or explicit loopback-only HTTP for local development.

origin.description: Receiver origin without a path or query, such as `https://receiver.example.com`.

path.description: Absolute request path on the configured origin, such as `/events`.

tls.description: Optional private CA and client identity secret references for HTTPS.

attemptTimeoutMilliseconds.description: Maximum time allowed for one attempt, in milliseconds.

maximumAttempts.description: Maximum total attempts in one delivery generation, including the first attempt.

caBundleRef.description:
PEM CA bundle secret reference, when the receiver uses a private
certificate authority. Omitted, the platform's trusted roots verify
the receiver. At least one of `caBundleRef` and `clientIdentityRef`
is written.

clientIdentityRef.description:
PEM client identity secret reference for mutual TLS. Omitted, the
registry presents no client certificate.

RawFieldEncryptionConfig.description: Raw `fieldEncryption` deployment block, absent by default.

RawFieldEncryptionProvider.description: Raw provider binding; the `type` member selects the custodian.

dekRef.description:
The data encryption key, named by a `secret:file/NAME` reference;
an environment reference is refused.

attemptTimeoutMilliseconds.description: Defaults to the bounded JWKS fetch timeout.

cacheTtlSeconds.description: Defaults to the bounded JWKS cache time-to-live.

maximumDocumentBytes.description: Defaults to the bounded maximum JWKS document size.

negativeCacheTtlSeconds.description: Defaults to the bounded JWKS negative-cache time-to-live.

outageToleranceSeconds.description: Defaults to the bounded cached-key outage tolerance.

refreshCooldownSeconds.description: Defaults to the bounded JWKS refresh cooldown.

bind.description:
Operator-private loopback or private numeric address and named port,
for example `127.0.0.1:9100`.

RawOidcVerifierConfig.description:
The OIDC issuer a runtime accepts access tokens from: the exact `iss`
value, the `aud` value a token must carry, and where the issuer's signing
keys come from, written under `authentication.oidc` beside the product's
own token rules.

accessTokenType.description:
The one admitted access-token `typ` semantics. Configuring the
RFC 9068 access-token media type as `at+jwt` or
`application/at+jwt` admits both spellings of that one type; any
other value (for example `JWT`) admits only that token type, matched
case-insensitively.

allowInsecureHttp.description:
Permit plain HTTP beyond loopback to the configured issuer and to a
JWKS URI declared in configuration. TLS remains required unless the
operator explicitly accepts this transport risk.

allowedClients.description:
The OAuth clients whose tokens this registry accepts: `unrestricted`
to accept a token from every client, or a list of at least one
client.

assertionIssuers.description:
The assertion authorities each client may exchange a subject token
from, keyed by client identifier. Omitted, no assertion-issuer rule
applies; written, it lists at least one client, each with at least one
authority, and a client not listed may exchange from no authority.

audience.description: The audience every accepted access token must carry in `aud`.

issuer.description:
Exact issuer accepted in access-token `iss` claims, an absolute
`https` URL, or a plain `http` URL when `allowInsecureHttp` is set.

jwksCache.description: Optional JWKS fetch and cache tuning. Defaults to bounded cache behavior.

jwksSource.description:
Where the issuer's signing keys come from. Absent reads the issuer's
OpenID Connect discovery document.

revokedKeyIds.description:
The signing key identifiers this registry refuses locally even while
the issuer publishes them. Omitted, no key is refused; written, it
names at least one key and does not revoke it at the issuer.

httpRequestMilliseconds.description: Defaults to the bounded per-request HTTP timeout.

migrationLockMilliseconds.description: Defaults to the bounded migration lock timeout.

migrationStatementMilliseconds.description: Defaults to the bounded migration statement timeout.

recordLockMilliseconds.description: Defaults to the bounded record lock timeout.

shutdownGraceMilliseconds.description: Defaults to the bounded graceful-shutdown timeout.

RawPackageConfig.description:
The package a runtime serves: `root` is the absolute package directory,
and `expectedDigest`, when set, pins the package digest the runtime must
find there. The package digest is the digest of the package's
`SHA256SUMS` file; see [`crate::package`].

expectedDigest.description:
`sha256:` label of the package digest, the digest of the package's
`SHA256SUMS` file. When set, the runtime refuses to start on any other
package.

root.description: Absolute path of the package directory.

createTimeoutMilliseconds.description: Defaults to the bounded PostgreSQL pool connection-creation timeout.

recycleTimeoutMilliseconds.description: Defaults to the bounded PostgreSQL pool connection-recycle timeout.

waitTimeoutMilliseconds.description: Defaults to the bounded PostgreSQL pool wait timeout.

RawRegistryDatabase.description:
The registry's database: the shared database block and the connection
pool and SQL roles the registry adds.

migrationUrlRef.description: Secret reference to the migration connection URL.

runtimeUrlRef.description: Secret reference to the least-privileged runtime connection URL.

testOnlyPlaintext.description: Allow a plaintext connection. Refused outside test builds.

trustedRootCertificateRef.description:
Secret reference to a PEM root certificate the connection trusts.
Absent, the connection trusts the platform's root certificates.

RawRegistryListener.description:
The registry's listener: the shared listener block and an optional public
origin.

publicOrigin.description:
Canonical public origin for QGIS discovery and pagination links, with
an optional deployment path prefix such as
`https://registry.example.org/breg`. It is `https`; `http` is accepted
only for a loopback host, for local development. Required when the
registry exposes GIS collections; omitted, the registry builds no
absolute discovery or paging links.

hookPayloadRetentionDays.description: Defaults to the bounded retained payload lifetime for pending or dead-letter hook work.

receiptRetentionDays.description:
Days a held response is kept after its commit. A retry after it is
refused as expired and never executed; the key stays spent.

completionRecipient.description:
The logical recipient the review authority names in each completion
notification. Written together with `completionTokenRef`; omitted, no
completion notification is accepted and the registry polls for
results.

completionTokenRef.description:
The bearer token the review authority presents when it notifies this
registry that a review completed. Written together with
`completionRecipient`; omitted, no completion notification is
accepted and the registry polls for results.

privateKeyJwt.description:
A refreshing client-assertion credential for the review service.
Exactly one of `tokenRef` and `privateKeyJwt` is written.

tokenRef.description:
A static bearer token for the review service. Exactly one of
`tokenRef` and `privateKeyJwt` is written.

caBundleRef.description:
A PEM bundle of the roots that sign the token endpoint's certificate.
Omitted, the platform's trusted roots verify it.

backend.description:
The backend handler modules are compiled and executed for: `pulley`
(default, the portable interpreter target) or `native`. Any other
value is refused as an invalid `wasmExecution` section.

maximumGuestMemoryBytes.description: Defaults to the platform guest-memory ceiling (32 MiB).

maximumModuleBytes.description:
Defaults to the default execution-time module ceiling (2 MiB); the
structural admission ceiling (5 MiB) is operator-reachable here.

RuntimeCredential.description:
The credential binding of one endpoint in the runtime config
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.2): Evidence's
`SourceAuthentication` variant field for field, minus the pack-side
`headerName` and `scheme`. The kind must match the endpoint's declared
kind; the checks refuse a mismatch.

oneOf.description: The static token, presented under the endpoint's declared `scheme`.
The static API key, sent in the endpoint's declared header.

The client-credentials binding, Evidence's fields: the token
endpoint, the client id, and the shared secret, all as references
or fixed strings.

assumedLifetimeSeconds.description: Lifetime assumed when the provider omits `expires_in`.

credentialPlacement.description: Where the shared client secret travels.

maximumCacheSeconds.description: The token cache ceiling, Evidence's bound.

resource.description:
RFC 8707 resource indicator sent as a token-request form
parameter.

tokenEndpoint.description:
The token endpoint, a fixed destination never derived from a
response; an absolute `http`/`https` URL the origin check
confines like any other destination.

oneOf.description:
The private-key-jwt binding, Evidence's fields. The signed
assertion always travels in the form body; there is no placement
parameter.

clientAssertionAudience.description:
Audience claim of the signed assertion, defaulting to the
token endpoint.

clientAssertionKeyRef.description: The private JWK the client assertion is signed with.

tokenEndpoint.description:
The token endpoint, a fixed destination never derived from a
response; an absolute `http`/`https` URL the origin check
confines like any other destination.

SecretProvidersConfig.description:
The secret providers a runtime enables. A reference is resolved only by a
provider declared here: `secret:file/name` under `file.root`, and
`secret:env/NAME` only when `environment: {}` is present.

environment.description:
Enables `secret:env/NAME` references, read from the process
environment. Declared as an empty mapping: `environment: {}`.

file.description: Enables `secret:file/name` references, read from files under `root`.

SecretReference.description: An exact secret reference: secret:file/name, resolved under secretProviders.file.root, or secret:env/NAME, resolved only when secretProviders.environment is declared.

TaskGrantStatusConfig.description:
One task authority whose grants a runtime checks for fresh status, and the
runtime's own credentials for that check, written as one entry of
`taskGrantStatus`. The status route and scope default to Casework's.

baseUrl.description:
The authority's base URL the status check calls. It is `https`;
`http` is accepted only for a loopback host, for local development.

caBundleRef.description:
PEM CA bundle for the authority and its token endpoint. Omitted, the
platform's trusted roots verify them.

sourceIssuer.description:
The task authority's issuer, exactly as the authority states it,
including an absolute URN issuer. It is compared rather than fetched
and must be an absolute resource URI.

statusPath.description:
The status route appended to `baseUrl`'s path. It starts with `/` and
has exactly one whole `{grantId}` segment; every other segment uses
only letters, digits, `-`, `.`, `_`, and `~`. Omitted,
`/v1/task-grants/{grantId}/status`.

statusResource.description:
The audience the runtime requests its status credential for, an
absolute resource URI.

statusScope.description:
The one scope the runtime requests its status credential with.
Omitted, `casework:grants:status`.

TrustProfile.description:
One named private CA bundle: the absolute path of the process-local PEM
file the runtime reads.

caBundleFile.description: The absolute path of the PEM file holding the bundle's certificates.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host preserved as written, no user information, and no backslash, whitespace or control character. DNS case and equivalent IPv6 literals are permitted.

attachmentStorage.description: Defaults to PostgreSQL; S3 requires a bucket with versioning never enabled.

attachmentVerification.description: Optional external verdict hook. Disabled by default.

destinations.description:
Outbound destination bindings. Absent by default, which binds no
destination.

externalRefresh.description:
Managed scheduled and targeted refresh plans. Omission starts no
refresh worker and admits no source-change notifier.

externalSources.description: Independent acquisition bindings. Omission permits no source calls.

fieldEncryption.description:
Optional field-encryption data-key provider. Absent by default, which
serves unencrypted entities only.

logLevel.description:
Operational log level when `BREG_LOG` is not set. Defaults to `info`;
accepted values are `error`, `warn`, and `info`.

metricsListener.description:
Optional operator-private metrics listener. Absent by default, which
serves no metrics surface at all.

operationalTimeouts.description: Optional operational request, shutdown, locking, and migration timeout tuning.

retention.description:
Optional retention windows for idempotency receipts and retained
event payloads. Defaults to a seven-day receipt horizon and the
server's bounded payload retention policy.

wasmExecution.description:
Optional WASM handler execution budgets. Parsed in every build;
executed only in builds with the `wasm` cargo feature, on by default.
